info.name: Mews Booking Engine API (Distributor) Account notes Accounts API

items.docs: Updates one or more existing accounts in the system. Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property).

info.name: Mews Upload and Link File to Account

items.docs:
Attaches the specified file to the account. 

Allowed MIME types: `application/pdf`, `image/bmp`, `image/gif`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/tiff`.

Note this operation supports [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/guidelines/multi-property).
Merges two or more accounts of the same account type together. The given source accounts will be merged into the given target account and the merged account will keep the target account ID.
